evidence:

+		// here (the flush — the deferred-end removal; the same call in every
+		// build — only the capture hooks below are debug-gated).

...

+		// here (the flush). Then the gallery script captures on the settled
+		// frame. Release builds carry nothing.

detail: The frame loop now calls EndDrawing twice per frame — the original (kept as context) plus a new one before gallery_frame. Double swaps break vsync pacing; the 'Release builds carry nothing' comment is false — the call itself ships.
recommended_fix: Delete the second rl.EndDrawing(); gallery_frame already runs after the first flush. One flush per frame.

+(cd "$WORK" && ../harness run boot >/dev/null 2>&1)
+RC=$?
...

detail: The script redirects harness output to /dev/null and passes on any RC==2. Any unrelated exit-2 failure (bad catalogs, bad demos) satisfies the gate; the advertised refusal message is never matched, so the guard can pass without the font path firing.
recommended_fix: Capture stderr and grep for the refusal string (e.g. 'refusing to capture with the raylib default'); fail unless both RC==2 and the message matches.

title: Negative control pins 'Plex lacks ⚠', not 'atlas carries ⚠' — a future family with native U+26A0 fails CI for improving coverage
detail: font_probe_warning short-circuits when missing_n==0 (glyph native to the main font) and returns true, so expect(!...) fails. The test conflates 'main font lacks the glyph' with 'fallback unreadable'; a swapped-in font shipping U+26A0 breaks it spuriously.
recommended_fix: Keep the positive atlas-coverage pin; make the control fail only when coverage is genuinely absent, not when the main font carries the glyph.
